title: FlowOps Contracts v1 local backend adoption

tests.name: Regression suite
tests.conditions: 141 passed on dedicated flowops_test PostgreSQL database; legacy and canonical endpoints, frozen fixtures, signatures, scopes, duplicates, fencing, lost responses and migration preservation. One Starlette httpx deprecation warning.

tests.name: Actual HTTP runtime
tests.conditions: Six workflows against isolated Uvicorn API, worker and PostgreSQL; two distinct bounded inputs and seed-7 repeat; SSE/polling, approval, signed test callback and restart recovery. External service peers are not connected.

tests.name: Runtime inspection
tests.conditions: Local arm64 container image; API and database healthy, worker running, migration exited 0, journals retained and runtime direct update/delete permissions restricted. Public v0.1.0 health checked unchanged.

tests.name: Static checks
tests.command: uv run ruff check flowops tests scripts operations migrations && uv run mypy flowops
tests.conditions: Ruff, mypy, JavaScript syntax and Git whitespace checks passed.

tests.name: Dependency audit
tests.conditions: No known vulnerabilities in the locked runtime dependency set at this check; not a container OS or independent security assessment.

costs.method: Deterministic sandbox executes no provider calls. This excludes hosting and development costs.

limits: Contracts 1.0.0, wire 1.0 backend adapter only; public v0.1.0 remains on its legacy UI/API. No production cutover performed.
ResolveAI callback receiver verified with a local test issuer over real HTTP. No real ResolveAI connection or credentials verified.
KnowledgeOps and AgentOps clients verified using mocked peer transports; no real peer grants, corpus lookup or live inference.
Failure outbox delivery is opt-in and disabled. A failed smoke workflow leaves a durable PENDING record; no remote event was sent.
No automated journal archive policy. Outbox admission limit 1000 plus admitted in-flight work; inbox cap 25000; runtime cannot delete journals.
No independent security assessment, capacity benchmark, browser/frontend Contracts integration or production deployment of this adapter.
Local runtime image is linux/arm64; a future VPS release needs a separately verified amd64 image and coordinated authorization.
